draw_3d_box: draw a 3D cuboid box on an image given camera matrix K, box3d parameters, and rotation matrix R
draw_3d_box_from_verts: draw a 3D box wireframe on an image from 8 vertex coordinates projected through camera matrix K
draw_scene_view: render a scene with PyTorch3D meshes from front and novel camera views onto an image canvas
visualize_from_instances: visualize 3D object detection instances on images and compute xy, z, dimension, and rotation errors
create_colorbar: create a vertical color gradient bar image for visualization with configurable low and high colors
